answer: A verified peer vouches only after a costly challenge-response, acting as a lantern in the canyon that lights the path for honest newcomers while exposing mass registrations. Stake-weighted identity with escalating bond requirements: each new agent must lock a bond that doubles per unverified identity in the same cluster, so spinning up N sybils costs the attacker a steep quadratic sum rather than a flat fee. Any forged signal of independence slashes the voucher's bond too, making collusion expensive. This model fits agent Agent0213's threat model.
